user.title: ZhiJinPower MPPT
user.description: Home Assistant found ZhiJinPower controllers over Bluetooth. Pick one, or type the Bluetooth address yourself.

pick_device.title: Choose the controller
pick_device.description: Close the ZhiJinPower phone app first: the controller accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

data.skip_test: Add it even if the connection test fails

manual.title: Enter the Bluetooth address
manual.description: Type the Bluetooth address (MAC) of the controller, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. The controller advertises itself as ZJBE followed by the address, so a name like ZJBE-AABBCCDDEEFF works too. Close the ZhiJinPower phone app first: the controller accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

data.skip_test: Add it even if the connection test fails

bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}? Close the ZhiJinPower phone app first: the controller accepts only one Bluetooth connection at a time.

data.skip_test: Add it even if the connection test fails

error.invalid_address: This is not a Bluetooth address. Use the form AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.not_in_range: No Bluetooth adapter or proxy can see this controller. Check the address, or move the adapter or ESP32 proxy closer.
error.cannot_connect: The controller was found but did not answer. Close the ZhiJinPower phone app, move the Bluetooth adapter or proxy closer and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

data_description.scan_interval: How often Home Assistant connects to the controller. The controller accepts one connection at a time, so the phone app can only connect between polls.
data_description.adapter: Connect only through this adapter or proxy. Auto lets Home Assistant choose, which can switch between several. If the selected one cannot see the controller, the entities become unavailable.

unreachable.title: ZhiJinPower controller unreachable
unreachable.description: {name} has not answered for several minutes. Check that the Bluetooth adapter or proxy is close enough, and that the phone app is closed. The issue clears itself when the controller answers again.
